comment: The pulse roster (D139, five at D203): a short question answered once per scheduled day and drawn as a line. Exactly five ordered options each — the trends chart's y-axis is the 1..5 step scale, and the card renders five growing dots. `pace` shipped first and deliberately neutral, because a wellbeing question moves the App Store's Health row; D166 §3 weighed that and approved the full roster, so `sleep` and `energy` are here and docs/STORE-FORMS.md answers Health YES accordingly. EVERY PULSE ASKS EVERY DAY (2026-09-12, the owner: "they should all be on everyday") and they ride the FEED rather than stacking above it, so this file no longer has a rhythm to keep out. What is per-person device state is the PIN — `insight.pulsePins.v1`, at most three, which pulses you are tracking and therefore meet near the head of the feed. The bank says what may be asked; the phone says what you are tracking, and neither reaches the other. A pulse may carry `since` (`YYYY-MM-DD`, the first day it existed) once one is WRITTEN rather than shipped: the reading must not report the days before it as misses. None of the five carries one. Ids stay underscore-free — `_` is the day separator the rules parse the answer id on. `pace` keeps its option set forever (D52 freezes a shipped one); a reworded pulse is a new id, never an edit here. No provenance rows: the pulse bank is editorial-only and outside the farm's lanes.

questions.prompt: How clear was your head today?
How connected did you feel today?
